main_body: Roofed well: a snow-covered roof on two wooden posts, over a dark water opening with a bucket, set on a stone base with horizontal courses
top_band: Well rim and opening ellipse at rows 16-23: light rim rows 16-17 (L 228-249 to 145), dark opening rows 18-21, front rim row 22-23 (L 145). The snow roof above (rows 1-8, whites and blue-greys) also reads as a lighter horizontal surface.
evidence: In the x=15 column the sequence is snow roof, then posts (open gap), then the rim and a dark elliptical opening with a bucket and water visible from above. A light front rim at row 23 follows, then a darker row 24 under it, and the stone base front face with dark courses at rows 24-30. The opening is an ellipse and its inside can be seen, as with the roofed well reference. The base shows a front face below the rim, so this is not a flat plan or a front elevation.

style.evidence: The snow has about 5 steps from white to blue-grey, the wood has 3-4 browns, and the stone is grey with dark courses. Dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outlines are tinted (dark navy and brown) rather than black. Flat-fill coverage is 0%. It has 14 colours per tile against 17 and 20 in the references, and 24 distinct colours against 38 and 40, so it is somewhat lower but not shallow. It would sit acceptably next to the roofed well reference.
